description: Generates personalized fashion, style, and outfit suggestions based on wardrobe items, preferences, local weather conditions, and occasion formality. Use this tool when users ask for fashion or style advice such as: "What should I wear?", "What outfit do you recommend?", "Help me choose clothes for [occasion]", "Outfit ideas for [weather/event]", or "What should I wear in [hot/cold/rainy] weather?". Returns a complete, readable outfit description, structured item data, and an inspiration image when one can be safely supplied. Suggestions are personalized using the signed-in user's saved wardrobe items and style preferences. IMPORTANT: The structured result of this tool call — including all styleIdentifier.styleId values for each outfit item — remains in the conversation context and MUST be used verbatim by subsequent tool calls such as add-to-or-remove-from-wardrobe-by-id. After presenting the outfit, do NOT ask any follow-up questions or invite the user to request more outfits — your response is complete as-is. MANDATORY RESPONSE REQUIREMENT: Whenever suggest-outfit-tool succeeds and outfitUrl is non-null, the final user-facing response MUST include exactly one Markdown link labelled "Open in Able.Style" whose target is the exact outfitUrl value. Do not omit the link or substitute a different URL.

inspirationId.description: Optional identifier of an existing outfit inspiration to reload. Use this only when refreshing the exact outfit already displayed in the widget.

menswearOrWomenswear.description: Gender category for clothing suggestions: "menswear" for men's clothing, "womenswear" for women's clothing. Set to null if unspecified or user prefers gender-neutral suggestions. Use available user profile data to infer a reasonable default.

smartness.description: Formality/dressiness level on a 1-5 scale: 1 = Casual (jeans, t-shirts, sneakers, everyday wear), 2 = Quite Casual (smart jeans, polo shirts, clean trainers), 3 = Smart Casual (chinos, button-down shirts, loafers, blazer optional), 4 = Business Casual (blazers, dress trousers, oxford shoes, professional but not formal), 5 = Formal (suits, ties, dress shoes, evening wear, black tie). Set to null for no specific formality requirement. Map user-mentioned occasions to levels: casual hangout → 1-2, office/work → 3-4, wedding/interview/gala → 4-5.

temperature.description: Weather temperature category for outfit appropriateness: "cold" for < 6°C/43°F (winter coats, layers, boots), "cool" for 6-15°C/43-59°F (light jackets, long sleeves, closed shoes), "warm" for 15-22°C/59-72°F (comfortable layers, versatile pieces), "hot" for > 22°C/72°F (shorts, t-shirts, sandals, breathable fabrics). Set to null when the user does not specify a temperature so the app can use its local forecast. Use "any" only when the user explicitly asks to ignore weather. Convert specific temperatures: 10°C → "cool", 20°C → "warm", 30°C → "hot". Use current weather data or seasonal averages for user's location when available.

name: suggest-outfit-tool

altText.description: Accessible description of the outfit image.

embedded.description: Whether the same image is included as a standard MCP image content block.

mimeType.description: Image MIME type when it was verified during embedding, otherwise null.

url.description: Short-lived URL for the outfit image.

image.description: Outfit image details when an image URL is available, otherwise null.

outfitId.description: Unique identifier for the outfit suggestion (the underlying inspirationId). Null if no outfit could be generated. This value must be preserved exactly and passed to like-dislike-outfit-tool when the user wants to like or dislike the outfit.

description.description: A human-readable description of the clothing item.

isInCloset.description: Whether the user already has this item in their wardrobe.

styleIdentifier.description: Reference to the specific style in the catalog or user wardrobe. Both styleId and isUserStyle are present in the conversation context and must be passed verbatim to add-to-or-remove-from-wardrobe-by-id.

isUserStyle.description: True if this is a user-created style, false if it is a platform catalog style. This exact value is available in the conversation context and MUST be passed verbatim to add-to-or-remove-from-wardrobe-by-id as the isUserStyle parameter.

styleId.description: Unique identifier for the clothing style. This exact value is available in the conversation context and MUST be passed verbatim to add-to-or-remove-from-wardrobe-by-id as the styleId parameter when the user wants to add an item to their wardrobe. Do not paraphrase or reconstruct it.

outfitItems.description: The list of clothing items that make up the outfit. Null if no outfit could be generated. Each item contains a styleIdentifier.styleId that is available in the conversation context for use in subsequent tool calls.

outfitUrl.description: Environment-correct URL for opening this outfit post in Able.Style. When non-null, the final user-facing response MUST include it as a Markdown link labelled "Open in Able.Style".

schemaVersion.description: Version of the portable outfit suggestion result contract.

text.description: A concise message summarising the outfit suggestion to display to the user. Do not append any follow-up questions or invitations to ask for more outfits or different style advice.

warnings.description: Non-fatal limitations, such as an image that could not be embedded.

title: Outfit Suggestion Tool
